about_the_game:
Tarogue is Tarot-Inspired Roguelike Deckbuilder, which combines synergistic, satisfying gameplay with immersive, atmospheric lore-depth. Players draft Tarot-cards and gather trinkets. You fight by laying out a spread of Tarot-cards, manipulating them and watch as the points rack up!

BUILD YOUR TAROT SPREAD

Draft from +150 cards - the Major Arcana cards, the cards of the four Suits; Wands, Cups, Swords, and Coins, and from the flipped versions of all cards. Improve your collection with small Trinkets and engraved Sigil stones. Warp your cards with Blessings and Curses. Lay out your cards and manipulate the board!

MEET THE FOUR COURTS

In Tarogue you explore the four courts; Wands, Cups, Swords, and Coins. You battle each faction’s Kings and Queens - but along the way you can also pick up cards and tune in to the strategies of the different suits.

Battle with the fiery, impulsive Wands.

The Wands Faction is a collective of performers and artists. They are fast-paced and live in the present. They swap, buff and destroy their cards for immediate effect.

Work with the adaptable, fostering Cups.

The Cups Faction are healers and nurturers. They cherish relationships and work towards synergies. This faction goes wide and focuses on connections and boosts between cards.

Fight alongside the clever and cunning Swords.

The Swords Faction is a militant group. They concern themselves with the future and long-term strategy. This faction can be ruthless and can accept sacrifice in return for eventual victory.

Use the ambitious and resourceful Coins.

The Coins Faction consists of merchants and traders. They value material possessions and will work to gather coins, trinkets and sigils. This faction tends to focus on economy and permanent growth of a few cards.

UNRAVEL ARCANE MYSTERIES

The four Courts and the Major Arcana characters are filled with false prophets, deceptive generals and dishonest rulers.

Are you ready to uncover the secrets?

FEATURES:

  • Build your own Tarot-deck

  • Adopt the unique play styles of each suit

  • Battle the Kings and Queens

  • Shop Trinkets from the Sun and Moon

  • Engrave Sigils with the Star

  • Spin the Wheel of Fortune

  • Curse and Bless your cards with the Magician

  • Uncover the occult secrets of the Courts...

name: Tarogue
short_description: TAROGUE is a challenging Tarot Roguelike Deckbuilder. You are The Fool. 🃏 Craft your deck, discover synergies, and uncover the secrets of the four factions; Wands, Cups, Swords, and Coins. Dive into the occult and unravel the mysteries of Kings, Queens, and Aces. Welcome to the Courts!
